Calcutta High Court Orders CCTV Footage Preservation in Raid Case

The Calcutta High Court has ordered the preservation of CCTV footage related to a 5 AM raid at the residence of TMC MP Abhishek Banerjee. The court also rejected an urgent hearing plea from Banerjee seeking permission for foreign travel. These decisions stem from a legal challenge concerning the raid and Banerjee's travel plans.
